lines.text: Many learners say: I forgot my sleep bag.
Better: I forgot my sleeping bag.
It's a bag for sleeping, so use sleeping.
Sleeping bag! Pack your sleeping bag for the camping trip.

data.why: It's a bag for sleeping, so use sleeping.
